sections.h2: Inflatable hire for every kind of event
sections.html:
From a single bouncy castle for a garden party to a 220ft obstacle course, rodeo bull and a field full of inflatable games for a corporate fun day, JM Inflatable Hire has the stock and the crew to make it happen. Everything you see on this site is our own stock, kept in our own warehouse and set up by our own team.

Every hire includes delivery, professional set-up, a full safety check and collection. Add operators and staff so your guests are looked after all day, or combine inflatables with arcade games, simulators and side stalls from the wider JM Entertainment range.

• Huge range in one place – castles, slides, assault courses, games, challenges and rodeo rides.
  • Live stock and availability straight from our booking system, so you know what's free before you call.
  • Fixed, clear pricing with multi-day discounts shown on every product.
  • Safety first – PIPA-tested inflatables, PAT-tested blowers and trained, DBS-checked crew.
  • Nationwide coverage for corporate events, schools, councils, festivals and private parties.
  • Fully insured, with risk assessments supplied once you've booked.

sections.h2: Popular for corporate fun days, schools and festivals
sections.html: Our inflatables are booked for staff summer parties, family fun days, team building, school sports days and summer fairs, university freshers' events, shopping-centre activations, council events, festivals, weddings and birthday parties. Mix and match – assault course races, a Gladiators duel and a rodeo bull together make a brilliant It's-a-Knockout style day.

faq.q: How much does inflatable hire cost?
faq.a: Bouncy castles start from £85 + VAT per day and larger event inflatables such as assault courses, Wipeout and rodeo bulls start from around £450–£695 + VAT. Delivery, set-up and collection are included on most UK bookings. Multi-day hires are discounted – a two-day hire costs roughly 1.5 days and longer hires work out cheaper per day. Each inflatable's page shows 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7-day prices.

faq.q: Do you deliver inflatables nationwide?
faq.a: Yes. Our crews deliver, set up and collect across England, Scotland and Wales – from London and the South East to Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, Newcastle, Glasgow and Cardiff.

faq.q: What power do inflatables need?
faq.a: Most inflatables run from one standard 13 amp socket within 25 metres for the electric blower. No power on site? We can supply a petrol blower or generator – just ask when you book.

faq.q: Can inflatables be used outdoors on grass?
faq.a: Yes – grass is ideal. We stake every inflatable down and supply safety mats. On hard ground or indoors we use sandbags and crash mats instead. Inflatables can't be used in high winds or heavy rain, so our crew will advise on the day.

faq.q: Are your inflatables safety tested?
faq.a: Every inflatable is PIPA tested, cleaned and checked before each hire, and all blowers are PAT tested. We hold public liability insurance; risk assessments and insurance documents are supplied once your booking is confirmed.

items.q: What is included in the hire price?
items.a: Delivery, set-up, a safety check, the blower, stakes or sandbags, safety mats and collection are included on most UK bookings. Operators can be added for any attraction and are included with every rodeo bull.

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: Summer weekends, bank holidays and the June–July corporate and school season book up first – we recommend booking 6–12 weeks ahead for those dates. Midweek and out-of-season dates can often be booked at short notice. Check live availability on any product page.

items.q: Can we check availability online?
items.a: Yes. Every product page and our availability checker read live stock from our booking system, so you can see what is free on your date before you enquire.

items.q: Do you offer discounts for multi-day hire or several attractions?
items.a: Yes. Multi-day hires are discounted – each product page shows 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7-day prices – and we put together package prices when you book several attractions for the same event.

items.q: Do prices change at weekends or bank holidays?
items.a: Our published prices are the same every day of the week. Delivery to some areas is quoted separately with your booking.

items.q: Is there a deposit, and when is the balance due?
items.a: Your quote sets out the deposit, balance date and cancellation terms before you confirm, so there are no surprises.

items.q: Can businesses and schools pay by invoice?
items.a: Yes. We invoice companies, schools, universities, councils and charities and can work with purchase orders.

items.q: Do you have a price list or brochure we can share?
items.a: Every inflatable has its own page with live prices, sizes and photos, which you can share with colleagues. Ask and we will send a tailored quote you can forward for sign-off.

items.q: How much space does an inflatable need?
items.a: Each product page lists the inflatable's size. Allow roughly 1–2 metres extra on each side for staking, safety mats and access, and more for large assault courses and Wipeout arenas. Send us your space and we will confirm what fits.

items.q: What power do you need?
items.a: Most inflatables run from one standard 13 amp socket within about 25 metres per blower. Larger set-ups need more than one socket. With no power on site we can supply a petrol blower or a generator.

items.q: Can we use inflatables indoors?
items.a: Yes – many of our inflatables suit sports halls, marquees and event venues. Tell us the ceiling height and floor type: we use sandbags and crash mats instead of stakes indoors.

items.q: What surfaces can you set up on?
items.a: Grass is ideal. We can also set up on tarmac, concrete, artificial turf and hall floors using sandbags, groundsheets and crash mats.

items.q: What access do you need for delivery?
items.a: Tell us about steps, narrow gates, lifts and the distance from where we can park. Most inflatables are moved on trolleys and need a standard doorway; large items may need wider access.

items.q: Can you deliver to city-centre offices and venues with loading bays?
items.a: Yes. We regularly work with venue loading bays, booked access times and parking restrictions – share the venue's delivery rules and we will plan around them.

items.q: How long does set-up take?
items.a: Most inflatables are set up in 30–60 minutes. Large assault courses and multi-attraction fun days take longer, so we arrive in good time to be ready before your guests.

items.q: What happens if it rains?
items.a: Light rain is usually fine, although surfaces get slippery so play may be paused. Some castles have rain covers. In heavy rain we stop play for safety.

items.q: What if it is too windy?
items.a: Every inflatable has a manufacturer's wind limit – typically around 24mph for most inflatables – and our crew will stop play or deflate if that is reached. We watch the forecast with you in the days before your event.

items.q: Can we move our event indoors if the weather turns?
items.a: If your venue has a hall or marquee with enough height and space, we can often set up inside instead. Talk to us before the day so we can plan for both.

items.q: Are your inflatables safety tested?
items.a: Yes. Our inflatables are PIPA tested, and every one is cleaned and checked before each hire. Blowers and electrical items are PAT tested.

items.q: Do you have public liability insurance?
items.a: Yes. We hold public liability insurance and send the certificate to you or your venue once your booking is confirmed.

items.q: Can you supply risk assessments and method statements?
items.a: Yes. We supply risk assessments, method statements and safety documents for your venue or event safety officer once you have booked.

items.q: Do you provide operators?
items.a: Rodeo bulls always come with a trained operator. For other inflatables you can add our operators, or we brief your own supervisors on the safe-use rules before we leave.

items.q: Are there age, height or weight limits?
items.a: Each product page states who it suits. Some attractions are for children only, many are for adults and children, and rodeo rides have their own guidance that the operator will explain.

items.q: Do people need to remove shoes and glasses?
items.a: Yes – shoes, glasses, jewellery and sharp objects must come off before using any inflatable. No food, drink or face paint on the inflatables either.

items.q: Can people with limited mobility take part?
items.a: Tell us about your guests and we will suggest attractions that work for them – inflatable games such as giant darts, penalty shoot-outs and Connect 4 can be played standing or seated.

items.q: How are the inflatables cleaned?
items.a: Every inflatable is cleaned, dried and checked between hires.

items.q: Can you run a team-building competition?
items.a: Yes. Assault course races, Wipeout, bungee runs, Gladiator duels and inflatable games work well as an It's-a-Knockout style tournament with teams, heats and a final. Add operators and we will help run it.

items.q: How many guests can use the attractions per hour?
items.a: It depends on the attraction: a two-lane assault course or bungee run can race a new pair every couple of minutes, while rides such as the rodeo bull take one person at a time. For big staff events we recommend a mix of high-throughput races and crowd-pleasers.

items.q: Can inflatables be branded with our logo?
items.a: Ask us about branding options for your event – JM Entertainment also supplies branded games and machines.

items.q: Will you work with our venue or event agency?
items.a: Yes. We liaise directly with venues, event managers and agencies on access, power, timings and paperwork.

items.q: Do you work at universities and freshers' fairs?
items.a: Yes. Inflatables, rodeo bulls and challenges are popular for freshers' weeks, student union events and campus open days.

items.q: Do we need permission to use an inflatable in a public park?
items.a: Usually yes. Most councils and park managers require an event booking or permission for inflatables, and may ask for our insurance and risk assessment, which we supply once you have booked.

items.q: Do you cover the whole UK?
items.a: Yes. Our crews deliver, set up and collect across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Delivery to some areas is quoted with your hire.
